verdict.rationale: Unstructured is an API-driven SaaS platform, so issuing scoped credentials to agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never describes per-key scopes, permission-limited API keys, or agent-specific credentials. The closest items are platform-wide IP allowlisting on dedicated instances, multi-user access on enterprise plans, and a generic mention of authentication in the security overview. None of these is least-privilege credential issuance.
